pairs.subject: copy-quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/lib/catalog/generate.ts:32 The catalog ad copy generator mutates copy by slicing words and appending ellipses to force-fit character limits instead of reporting length budget violations to an authoring quality gate.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/catalog/generate.ts:78 The FloorClaims interface restricts ad copy promises strictly to verifiable shop facts (shipping, rating, returns, dispatch), omitting missing fields rather than inventing claims.

src/lib/catalog/generate.ts:32 fit() mutates copy by slicing at word boundaries and appending an ellipsis to force-fit character limits, violating the rule that repairs altering words or meaning are not deterministic repair classes and must be reported.
src/lib/catalog/generate.ts:10 Limits are implemented as bare character limits (RSA_HEADLINE_MAX = 30) without rendered box budgets or early-warning thresholds on source copy at 85% of budget.

src/lib/catalog/ad-copy.ts:64 sanitizeAdCopy bounds string lengths and counts but performs no anchored model review (no binary surface checklist, rule identifiers, verbatim span check, or consensus sampling).
src/lib/catalog/ad-copy-store.ts:49 recordAdCopy mutates project state directly without passing generated ad copy through an end-of-session or write-seam copy quality gate.

src/lib/catalog/validate.ts:141 sanitizeOfferings validates entities and bounds properties but implements no format-aware copy check catalog for catalog text attributes (syntax, markup, literals, whitespace).
src/lib/catalog/ad-copy.ts:160 Ad copy is transformed into asset groups with limits without a layered mechanical gate that stops on deterministic L1 failures.

pairs.subject: copy-quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/components/app/modules/CatalogModule.tsx:148 The catalog module displays length overflow as an advisory visual badge rather than enforcing a blocking quality gate prior to clipboard copy or CSV export.

techniques.evidence: src/components/app/modules/CatalogModule.tsx:148 Length overflow is treated merely as an advisory UI styling flag (over ? 'text-negative' : 'text-muted') rather than a blocking L1 gate that halts copy export.
src/components/app/modules/CatalogModule.tsx:152 Length is tracked only as a character counter in a UI badge with no pixel-rendered font box measurement or non-dismissible overflow blocking.

src/components/app/modules/catalog/useAdCopyBatch.ts:86 Batch ad generation receives model responses from /api/ai and immediately converts them to stored copy without anchored binary review, rule citation, or multi-sample consensus.

src/components/app/modules/catalog/ad-copy-actions.ts:30 saveAdCopyAction persists freshly generated copy directly via recordAdCopy without running any copy quality gate at the server action write seam.
src/components/app/modules/CatalogModule.tsx:186 Copy actions allow unvetted batch export to clipboard and CSV without role-separated review or sampling discipline.

declined.subject: copy-quality-gates
declined.reason: Framework-free utility primitives provide low-level formatting, HTML sanitisation, and type definitions with no catalog copy drafting pipeline, write seams, or copy quality gates; the subject's preconditions do not hold here.
